voice.summary: Healcure speaks like a calm, experienced nurse: reassuring, clear and free of jargon. It puts the next step for the patient first and never overstates what medicine can promise.
dos: Explain every service in plain words
Put the next step, like booking, first
donts: Do not make medical claims or guarantees
Never use jargon without a gloss

taglines: Healthcare for good, today and always
boilerplate: Healcure is a trusted healthcare platform helping people book appointments, explore services and take charge of their well-being with modern, accessible care.

microcopy.success: Appointment booked. We will confirm by email.
microcopy.error: We could not book that slot. Please choose another time.
microcopy.empty: No appointments yet. Book your first visit.

logo.note: A heartbeat line is the clearest universal sign for healthcare.
